title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 174 ]

blocks.text: Since the end of the war in 1953, the country began to develop very quickly, especially during the 1970’s.
From then until now, the country has continued to grow rapidly.
In 1988, Korea hosted the Summer Olympic Games and in 2002, the World Cup was held in Korea, too.
I am very proud of my country and what it has accomplished during its long history.
